hero.label: Made for Reframe (Glucobit)
hero.headline: I want to help Reframe build the community that changes how people drink.
hero.subheadline: Behavior-change is one of the hardest problems in consumer health, and Reframe is solving it with social proof, community, and content rather than shame or willpower lectures. That approach is genuinely different, and I want to be part of scaling it. The Social Media and Outreach Manager role sits exactly at the intersection of where I have real reps: outbound relationship-building, content-driven lead gen, and mission-led storytelling.

whyCompany.title: Community-led growth in behavior change is a rare and powerful wedge
whyCompany.body: Most wellness apps compete on features. Reframe competes on identity and belonging, which is a much stickier moat. Users who feel seen by the content and connected to a community do not churn the same way. That insight shapes everything about how the social and outreach function should operate.

whyCompany.title: This is a build-the-playbook moment, not a maintain-the-playbook moment
whyCompany.body: Reframe is growing fast enough to be hiring a dedicated social and outreach manager, which means the systems are not fully locked in yet. That is the most interesting moment to join a growth role because the decisions made now compound for years. I want to be the person making those calls, not inheriting them.

whyCompany.title: My BDR and NextAfter experience maps directly to what this role demands
whyCompany.body: At Copygen.ai I ran cold outreach sequences on LinkedIn and HubSpot that contributed to acquiring 15 to 20 paying clients from scratch, so I know what it takes to get a response from a stranger. At NextAfter, a B2B digital fundraising consultancy, I worked inside a research-driven content culture where every message was tested for conversion. Reframe needs both of those things: disciplined outreach and content that actually moves people.

quote: I spent over a year convincing strangers to care about something new, and then spent a summer learning how to make content that earns trust before you even ask. Reframe is the first place I have seen that actually needs both of those skills working together, and I would rather build that here than anywhere else.
